name: xTool M1 + RA2 Pro (chuck)
description: xTool M1 diode laser with the RA2 Pro rotary in chuck mode, using xTool Studio.
notes: The RA2 Pro replaces the Y axis, so the rotation runs along the image height.
The rotation axis direction is 90°: the vertical direction of the image runs along the rotation axis.
In rotary mode set the object diameter to the ball diameter.
A diode laser marks coatings and paint, not clear glass: engrave the coating on the bauble or a painted layer.
Focus on the top of the ball. Keep the image small: the spot defocuses and stretches away from the top of the ball.
